chunks: Abdullah b. Muhammad al-Sa'igh (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Abu Hatim Muhammad b. Isa b. Muhammad al-Wasqindi narrated to us, saying: My father informed us, saying: Ibrahim b. Dizil narrated to us, saying: al-Hakam b. Sulayman al-Jabali Abu Muhammad narrated to us, saying: Ali b. Hashim narrated to us, from Mutayr b. Maymun, that he heard Anas b. Malik say: Salman al-Farisi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me that he heard the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say:
Surely, my brother, my vizier, and the best of those I leave behind after me is Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him.

key_terms.أخي: Akhi - my brother; the Prophet's declaration of spiritual brotherhood with Ali
key_terms.خير من أخلفه: Khayr man ukhallifuhu - the best of those I leave behind; an explicit designation of Ali's superiority as successor
key_terms.وزيري: Waziri - my vizier, minister; denoting Ali's role as the Prophet's chief advisor and helper

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali being his brother and vizier?
ai.summary: The Prophet (s) declares that Ali (as) is his brother, his vizier, and the best successor after him. This statement, narrated through a chain reaching Salman al-Farisi who heard it directly from the Prophet, is a direct prophetic tradition establishing the rank and authority of Imam Ali (as) as the Prophet's foremost successor.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Abdullah b. Muhammad al-Sa’igh (ra) narrated to us. He said: Abu Hatim Muhammad b. `Isa b. Muhammad al-Wasqindi narrated to us. He said: My father informed us. He said: Ibrahim b. Dizil narrated to us. He said: Al-Hakam b. Sulayman al-Jabali Abu Muhammad narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Hashim narrated to us from Matir b. Maymun that he heard Anas b. Malik say:  Salman al-Farisi (rh) narrated to me that he heard the Prophet (s) say:
Surely, my brother, my vizier, and the best of successors after me is `Ali b. Abi Talib (as).
